claims.claim_text: The Republican Party supports continuing to base U.S.-Taiwan relations on the Taiwan Relations Act.
The Republican Party affirms the Six Assurances given to Taiwan in 1982 by President Reagan.

The Republican Party opposes unilateral changes to the status quo in the Taiwan Straits by either side, on the principle that Taiwan's future must be resolved peacefully through dialogue and with the agreement of Taiwan's people.

If China violates the principles of resolving Taiwan's future peacefully, through dialogue and with the agreement of Taiwan's people, the United States will help Taiwan defend itself in accordance with the Taiwan Relations Act.
The Republican Party praises the new Taipei government's efforts, as described in its 2016 platform, to continue constructive cross-Strait relations.
The Republican Party calls on China to reciprocate Taipei's constructive cross-Strait relations.
The Republican Party regards Taiwan's friendship with the United States as meriting strong Republican support.
The Republican Party supports free-trade-agreement status for Taiwan.
The Republican Party supports timely sales of defensive arms to Taiwan, including technology to build diesel submarines.
The Republican Party supports Taiwan's full participation in the World Health Organization.
The Republican Party supports Taiwan's full participation in the International Civil Aviation Organization.
The Republican Party supports Taiwan's full participation in other multilateral institutions.
